description: This file defines a React functional component named ReportForm, which provides a form interface for creating and editing weekly reports. It manages form state, validation, and submission logic, and uses custom UI components for input fields.

methods.name: ReportForm
methods.description: React functional component for report creation/editing form, handling state, validation, and submission.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form inputs, ensuring content length and optional week format.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates form state for a given field.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs validation, normalizes data, and calls onSubmit callback.
